diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says VCC, datasheet reading says RST
diffs.evidence: DFRobot SEN0434 (STS35 Digital Temperature Sensor V1.0.0) silkscreen, back and front: the square pin-1 pad is labelled VCC, followed by GND, SCL, SDA, RST, ADDR, so header pin 1 is VCC. The second reading took the wiki pinout table order (RST, ADDR, SDA, SCL, GND, VCC), which is the same six pins read from the other end (ADDR end first on the front view), not pin-1-first. The reading's own caveat says it was not checked against a pinout image.
